mapper.sql: o.id, o.type, o.key, o.params, o.status, o.due, o.version, o.attempts, o.last_error, o.claimed_by, o.created_by, o.created, o.modified
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox (type, key, params, due, created_by) VALUES (#{type}::OUTBOXTYPE, #{key}, #{params, typeHandler=life.catalogue.db.type2.JsonNodeHandler}::jsonb, now() + #{delaySeconds} * interval '1 second', #{user}) ON CONFLICT (type, key) DO UPDATE SET params = outbox.params || EXCLUDED.params, due = CASE WHEN outbox.status = 'FAILED' THEN EXCLUDED.due ELSE LEAST(outbox.due, EXCLUDED.due) END, version = outbox.version + 1, attempts = CASE WHEN outbox.status = 'FAILED' THEN 0 ELSE outbox.attempts END, last_error = CASE WHEN outbox.status = 'FAILED' THEN NULL ELSE outbox.last_error END, status = CASE WHEN outbox.status = 'RUNNING' THEN 'RUNNING'::OUTBOXSTATUS ELSE 'PENDING'::OUTBOXSTATUS END, modified = now()
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM outbox o
ORDER BY o.due, o.id

SELECT count(*) FROM outbox o WHERE o.status = 'PENDING' AND o.due < now() - #{minutes} * interval '1 minute'
AND o.type NOT IN #{t}::OUTBOXTYPE

UPDATE outbox o SET status = 'RUNNING'::OUTBOXSTATUS, claimed_by = #{instance}, modified = now() FROM ( SELECT id FROM outbox WHERE type = #{type}::OUTBOXTYPE AND status = 'PENDING' AND due <= now() ORDER BY due, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) c WHERE o.id = c.id RETURNING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM outbox WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND claimed_by = #{instance}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox SET status = 'PENDING'::OUTBOXSTATUS, claimed_by = NULL, modified = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND claimed_by = #{instance}

UPDATE outbox SET status = 'PENDING'::OUTBOXSTATUS, claimed_by = NULL, attempts = attempts + #{inc}, due = now() + #{delaySeconds} * interval '1 second', last_error = #{error}, modified = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND claimed_by = #{instance}

UPDATE outbox SET status = CASE WHEN version = #{version} THEN 'FAILED'::OUTBOXSTATUS ELSE 'PENDING'::OUTBOXSTATUS END, attempts = CASE WHEN version = #{version} THEN attempts + 1 ELSE 0 END, claimed_by = NULL, last_error = #{error}, modified = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND claimed_by = #{instance}
UPDATE outbox SET status = 'PENDING'::OUTBOXSTATUS, claimed_by = NULL, modified = now() WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND claimed_by = #{instance}
UPDATE outbox SET status = 'PENDING'::OUTBOXSTATUS, claimed_by = NULL, modified = now() WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE outbox SET status = 'PENDING'::OUTBOXSTATUS, claimed_by = NULL, attempts = 0, due = now(), modified = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 'RUNNING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM outbox WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND modified < now() - #{days} * interval '1 day'
